ngaap.guidance: Withdrew 2020 financial guidance on May-4-2020 due to COVID-19 uncertainty (prior Feb-18 guidance excluded COVID impacts). Actions: footprint consolidation additional 9% in 2020, SG&A reduction, >40% capex reduction; liquidity ~$1.2bn at quarter end plus $600m 364-day facility entered after quarter end.
ngaap.notes: 2020 'adjusted' definition: excludes restructuring & transaction costs (incl. cost-of-sales portion), all non-cash intangible amortization expense, foreign exchange (and in Q3 interest) gains/losses in other income, and tax on transaction costs; all tax-effected. EBITDA (2020 definition) = income from operations + other income (expense) + depreciation & amortization; Adjusted EBITDA adds back restructuring & transaction costs. Q1-20 release also restates Q1-19 adjusted results on the 2020 definition (adjusted op income 233.4, adjusted EPS $1.21; 2020-definition EBITDA 113.7, adjusted EBITDA 252.4).
